faith.arabic: وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ أَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا لِّتَسْكُنُوا إِلَيْهَا
faith.quote: And among His signs is that He created for you spouses from among yourselves so that you may find comfort in them.
faith.closingPrayer: May Allah bless our union, fill our home with mercy, and keep our hearts close in faith and love. Ameen.

story.title: Two families, one beautiful dua
story.text: Every meaningful journey begins with a little hope, a lot of prayer, and the people who make life special.

story.title: A new chapter together
story.text: With gratitude in our hearts, we look forward to building a life filled with kindness, patience, and laughter.

story.title: A blessed beginning
story.text: We would be honoured to have you with us as we begin this new chapter.
